commits.messageHeadline: Plan packetized Supabase foundation and harden skill-wrapper checks.
Require RLS on create before client Data API grants.
Upgrade GitHub Actions checkout and setup-node to v6.
Align schema workflow, grants, and MCP with deny-by-default plan.
Reject unclosed quotes in skill-wrapper front matter.
Harden grants, rating policies, wrapper nulls, and Task 14 rate adapter.
Serialize aggregates, widen Task 11 paths, and tighten plan contracts.
Assign Rated Products, sync private-note UI, and fix rating write paths.
Align release checklist keyboard note with Private note label.
Require auth.users trigger to create profile rows on sign-up.
Replace the monolithic decisions log with a generated ADR index.
Tighten decision and skill-wrapper validators against false passes.
Ignore tilde-fenced headings in decision section validation.
Harden wrapper paths, fence closing, and Task 12 migration separation.
Harden ADR titles, archive integrity, and aggregate task ownership.
Require accepted supersessions, rating conflict retry, and strict ADR names.
Close Task 14–15 contract gaps and harden ADR title link safety.
Close privilege, helper-auth, and tooling review gaps.
Harden ADR validation and Browse price currency.
Require substantive ADR sections and align Task 11 constraints.
Ignore HTML comments in ADRs and lock rating identity.
Reject empty ADR markers and fix rating INSERT grants.
Lock versioned assessments and pin the skill inventory.
Scope Loop Index checks and make Task 17 mandatory.
Tighten Loop Index parsing and unblock Task 14 reads.
Require Loop Index triggers and nonnegative offer prices.
Reject offer NaN, nested ADRs, and account deletion.
Require offer currency, ADR guide, and auth/write modes.
Reject thematic breaks as empty ADR section content.
Ignore commented fences and document reset-password.
Require non-null MVP size_region on product offers.
Tighten skill-wrapper inventory and canonical checks.
Reject negative offer sizes and unmatched trigger comments.
Require substantive skill sections and reject empty HTML ADRs.

issueComments.author: tyson-hu
issueComments.body:
Closing this PR as superseded, with its head preserved unchanged at `68a2911183b4e99455a0ea71940b66ec30f41dd5` for reference.

## Final decomposition coverage

The replacement set is:

1. #15 — Browse currency runtime/display (`lowestPriceCurrency`, currency-aware formatting) plus the matching canonical product-data guidance.
2. #16 — Task 11–12 Supabase security foundation, including the Cursor security mirror; planning/contracts only, no database mutation.
3. #17 — generated skill discovery, JSON manifest/tests, GitHub Actions v6, and PR #14's connected-read / auth-connected / connected-write `feature-slice-builder` modes.
4. #18 — the ADR decision restructure: full legacy log archive, 18 active ADRs, generated `docs/DECISIONS.md`, validator/check wiring, and updated decision-memory pointers.
5. #19 — detailed Tasks 13–18 contracts: seed constraints, real Browse/Detail mapping, UUID-compatible transitional ratings, auth recovery and protected app-owned account deletion, private notes, Rated Products, rating conflict handling, aggregate verification, user-scoped query keys, plus matching design/user-flow/release/Stitch/loop guidance. This PR is stacked on #16.
6. #20 — global agent/MCP database authority: production DB work and agent/MCP account deletion are FORBIDDEN; canonical docs and Cursor mirrors are synchronized. This PR is stacked on #16.

## Final integrated-audit corrections

The final cross-PR review closed additional composition gaps:

- #15 now keeps the exact `ProductCardData` inventory synchronized with `lowestPriceCurrency`.
- #17 rejects empty canonical skill files and covers the guard with a 20th generator test; its auth routine requires human-run destructive account-deletion verification.
- #18 records the previously omitted single-currency offer, generated skill-discovery, and account-deletion authority decisions.
- #19 no longer allows seed/import code to write `rating_aggregates` directly, no longer references removed `source_type` fields or a nonexistent unresolved-decisions section, and makes the destructive deletion check human-owned.

## Deliberate supersessions, not omissions

A file-level audit of frozen PR #14 against #15–#20 found only two PR #14 paths not represented in a replacement: `scripts/check-skill-wrappers.cjs` and the corresponding direct `yaml` entry in `package-lock.json`. Both are intentionally superseded by #17's dependency-free JSON manifest generator and table-driven tests.

The detailed aggregate SQL from PR #14 is also intentionally not copied verbatim: the frozen head still had an unresolved product-delete cascade review finding and the SQL had not been runtime-tested. #16 preserves executable Task 11 acceptance criteria, and #19 preserves Task 17 verification/hardening; implementation belongs in the authorized, locally tested Task 11 packet.

`docs/notes/handoff.md` was not a tracked change at the frozen head, so stale session state is not being promoted into durable replacement work.

## Review and integration order

Run one focused code/contract review on every replacement PR; do not merge the six drafts unreviewed. Reviews can start on the isolated diffs now. Integrate in this order:

1. #15
2. #16
3. #20 — retarget to current `master` after #16 lands
4. #17
5. #19 — retarget to current `master` after #16/#20/#17 land
6. #18 — rebase/compose last so its generated index and overlapping workflow/check wiring reflect the final tree

After every retarget/rebase, rerun CI. Give #18's conflict-resolution/integration commit one final focused review before merging it.

No commit from PR #14 was cherry-picked wholesale, rebased, or used to move this branch head.
